name: Fly HV-TMC5160 Pro
description: The Mellow Fly HV-TMC5160 Pro is an external stepper motor driver module that communicates over SPI and is rated for 24-48 V DC input and up to 6 A maximum current. Two hardware revisions are documented on mellow.klipper.cn (V1.2 and V1.5); both revisions publish the same electrical parameters, including a 0.033 Ω sense resistor, so `run_current` values are consistent across revisions. Mellow lists stealthChop2, spreadCycle, dcStep, stallGuard2, and coolStep as the module's key TMC features, with up to 256 microsteps via the TMC microPlyer step/direction interpolator.
